svg.title: Shell startup belongs to the app

g.text: Shell startup belongs to the app
Cordyceps supplies injection values without reading, forwarding or changing startup files.

g.title: Injection values
g.desc: The consuming app owns shell setup and executable invocation. Cordyceps supplies injection values without managing startup files.

g.text: Past synthetic shell probes were exploratory; they are not a library support commitment.
The app owns .zshrc, environment caches, terminals and executable lookup on its chosen OS.
Architecture proposal · no library implementation claimed
